Name: Hector Quintanilla
Question: Should I share my dreams with everyone or silently just do it?
Answer: “You can’t do this!” “You’re too young!” “You have no experience!” “You have no money!” “What are you thinking!” To answer your question, you should be very careful WHO you share your dreams with. Know that your dreams will always be evaluated, filtered and criticized by the self imposed limitations of those you decide to trust your dreams with. In other words, if you share your dreams with losers, your dreams will get crushed. If you share your dreams with visionary people, they will push you to accomplish them. Who is your circle of influence? Who are you talking to? Be very selective with who you decide to share your dreams with. People will try to bring you down if they don’t have the courage to chase their dreams like you do. #BeBusinessSmart
